Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649943 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures (inner join). Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
